title: Who is defense witness Engineer John Kenneth Enumerables?
summary: The second witness for the defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte for her impeachment trial is Engineer John Kenneth Enumerables, the assessor of the Island Garden City of Samal.

blocks.text: The second witness for the defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte for her impeachment trial is Engineer John Kenneth Enumerables, the assessor of the Island Garden City of Samal.
Enumerables is a civil engineer who passed the licensure exam in year 2000.
Likewise, he is also a licensed real estate appraiser. He passed the board exam for real estate appraiser in 2011.

His testimony is being offered by the defense team to prove that the land under Transfer Certificate of Title 142-2019013134 in Samal Island is a declared asset of the Vice President under her Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) she jointly filed with her husband, Atty. Manases Carpio.

Prosecution witness and Acting Samal Register of Deeds Atty. Marco Pineda earlier told the Senate court testified that a P3.4 million property in the Island Garden City of Samal purchased in 2018 as reflected in the 2018 Deed of Absolute Sale is owned by the Vice President’s husband.
Pineda also testified that the said P3.4 million property is not listed as an asset of the Vice President in her joint SALN filing with her husband. —VAL, GMA News
